Subject: Follow-up: Security & Privacy questions from today's demo

Thanks again for taking the demo today, Jared — really appreciate the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

1) SOC 2 / compliance status
- Redwood is SOC 2 Type II in scope for our hosted platform; I've attached a one-page SOC 2 summary (redwood_soc2_summary.pdf). If you need the full report we can start an NDA/RoE exchange.

2) GDPR / HIPAA
- We support GDPR data subject requests and customer-configurable data retention. For HIPAA, Private deployments (VPC / on-prem) are covered under a BAA — we can share details if you're interested in that path.

3) Telemetry & cookies (console + docs)
- Console telemetry: event-level telemetry is used for performance & error monitoring; by default PII is not included in telemetry. We can provide the event schema and retention windows.
- Docs site: we use analytics (GA4) for aggregate traffic; user-level tracking is not enabled by default for docs.

4) Vendor security questionnaire (VSA)
- Happy to kick off your questionnaire. Rishi (cc'd) will own the Q&A and can coordinate uploads/attachments.

Next steps: 
- I'll share the SOC 2 summary and a VSA template now (attached).
- Can we schedule a 30m security deep-dive next week (I can do Mon 6/22 10:00am PT)?
- Please share the primary owner for the security questionnaire and any specific fields you want prioritized (e.g., data flow diagrams, encryption-at-rest keys, retention policies).

Thanks,

Thanks Marissa — good summary. A few clarifying questions before we loop in our InfoSec operations team: 

- Telemetry: where is telemetry stored/processed (region/cloud provider)? Are any PII fields collected by default or in any optional logging layers?
- Cookies/analytics: on the docs site and the admin console, what vendors are used (e.g., Google Analytics, Sentry, Hotjar)? Can we get a breakdown of which cookies are persistent vs. session and a mechanism to opt out?
- Retention: what are default retention windows for telemetry and raw logs? Is there a self-serve retention setting?

We also want to initiate our vendor security questionnaire — attaching our intake form on the next message would be ideal. The owner for this work is Elena Park on my team (cc or share her email).

On Fri, Jun 18, 2026 at 5:03 PM Jared Miller <security@acmehealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks Marissa — good summary. A few clarifying questions before we loop in our InfoSec operations team: 
> 
> - Telemetry: where is telemetry stored/processed (region/cloud provider)? Are any PII fields collected by default or in any optional logging layers?
> - Cookies/analytics: on the docs site and the admin console, what vendors are used (e.g., Google Analytics, Sentry, Hotjar)? Can we get a breakdown of which cookies are persistent vs. session and a mechanism to opt out?
> - Retention: what are default retention windows for telemetry and raw logs? Is there a self-serve retention setting?

Thanks — answered inline below.

- Telemetry: Processed in our US regions (AWS us-west-2 primary). By default telemetry is aggregated and PII is not stored; debug logs that may contain PII are only kept for a short retention window and require elevated access to export. We can provide the event schema and the default retention windows (30/90/365 days options).

- Cookies/analytics: Docs site uses Google Analytics (GA4) for aggregate traffic only; console uses small session cookies for login/session management and Sentry for error telemetry. No third-party session replay tools are enabled. We can provide a cookie table showing name, purpose, persistent/session, TTL and a consent/opt-out guidance.

- Retention: Default telemetry retention is 90 days for aggregated metrics, 30 days for debug logs; customers can request longer retention or self-host for enterprise/private deployments. For Dedicated/Private we provide controls to configure retention and log export.

I've attached an intake template (ACME_VSA_Template.xlsx) — Rishi will own the questionnaire responses and can coordinate attachments and evidence.

Proposed: Mon 2026-06-22 10:00am PT for a 30m call to go through the questionnaire and telemetry details. Rishi — can you pick this up? Jared — feel free to add Elena or the right owner.

Thanks,

Marissa
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: ACME_VSA_Template.xlsx
